frame_indexing: Zero-based source decoded frames. Intervals are [start,end). Source is 29.97002997 fps, not exactly 30.
measurement_note: Distances and hex colors are visual estimates, not world coordinates or colorimeter samples. Frame precision applies to visible events; obscured contact is explicitly bounded. No HUD coin/name labels are visible.
review: Whole video viewed at 6 fps; every source frame 330–1649 viewed in 44 contact sheets; selected frames enlarged. Old reports read only after the independent frame pass.
mapping_evidence: Three distinct target-contact episodes in one uninterrupted Rodion action: f1016, approximately f1038–1040, and f1140/1145.
Unlike Patterning, first two strokes are low sweeping cuts, not repeated overhead launches; follows three-coin S2 demonstration and precedes ally action.

No clear idle/reset between second sweep and the prolonged third-coin charge. The 36–39 s portion could be a separately edited Trimming counter, but no enemy approach/contact is visible. Do not claim that alternative as confirmed.
